verdict: Yes. Kanvas from Mumbai pitched heritage-inspired fashion footwear on Shark Tank India Season 4, but didn't get a deal. Kolhapuris, juttis and mojaris have modern appeal, and craft clusters make them.
angle: Traditional Indian footwear such as Kolhapuris and juttis is popular for weddings and festivals. Modern designs attract younger buyers. Craft clusters such as Kolhapur and Punjab make them.
